description: Land Title Settlement Department - Aluthgama, Kotavehera D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No. 421160 (23/0838)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration and determinations regarding specific parcels of land. It contains a declaration by the Commissioner of Title Settlement under the Registration of Title Act, listing numerous land parcels with their details (extent, ownership, class of title, etc.). The content falls squarely within the Land Gazette category as it involves land registration, title determinations, and property ownership matters, with no government personnel changes or structural administrative modifications.
